mentions.name: Unix-philosophy tooling for LLMs
mentions.description: A suite of tools for LLMs aimed at developers, built on Unix philosophy and pipes. It provides repository maps for quick codebase overviews, hybrid search for finding knowledge, tools, or skills, a linter for tools, and an external tools provider that is not MCP-based.
